# Covert Shores

> > Independent defence analysis focused on naval warfare, submarines, unmanned systems, and open-source intelligence (OSINT) across global maritime conflicts.

Covert Shores provides in-depth military intelligence analysis and technical documentation on naval technology, with particular expertise in submarine design, unmanned surface vehicles, and regional maritime conflicts. The site combines satellite imagery analysis, historical research, and current military developments across multiple theaters including the Black Sea, Middle East, and Indo-Pacific regions.

## Key Topics

- Submarine Analysis
- Naval Warfare
- Unmanned Surface Vehicles (USVs)
- OSINT & Satellite Imagery
- Military Intelligence
- Naval Mines
- Drone Technology
- Chinese Navy (PLAN)
- Russian Military
- Iranian Navy & IRGC
- Ukraine Conflict
- Maritime Security
- Naval Weapons Systems
- Military Vessels
- Submarine Design
